strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_break_entry
element_inventory: Precondition (timing): only trade at the regular-session open — be at the desk at 9:30 a.m. EST; the first candle of the day at 9:30 anchors the setup
Precondition (market-agnostic): works on any market (futures, stocks, crypto, forex) using the same 9:30 EST open time
Direction rule: break ABOVE the first-candle HIGH = bullish, take long trades (mirror: break below the LOW = bearish/short); the broken side determines trade direction
Qualifying-break gate: a valid break of the level must form a fair value gap — merely crossing the level with a wick or a candle closure does NOT qualify
FVG definition: a 3-candle formation leaving a gap between candle-1's wick and candle-3's wick, with an expansive middle candle showing force in the break direction
SCALPING variant — Step 1 (levels): on the 5-minute chart, mark the high and the low of the first 5-minute candle (9:30-9:35 EST)
SCALPING variant — Step 2 (direction confirm): switch to the 1-minute chart and wait for a break of the marked level that forms a fair value gap
SCALPING variant — Step 3 (entry): wait for a retest of the FVG (price trades back into the gap), then wait for the retest candle to get engulfed, and enter on the engulfing
SCALPING variant — engulfing definition: the body of the retest candle is completely closed through by opposing-direction candle(s)
SCALPING variant — stop loss: place it under the lowest area price traded into the FVG, plus one tick of breathing room
DAY-TRADING variant — Step 1 (levels): on the 15-minute chart, wait for the first 15-minute candle (9:30-9:45 EST) to close, then mark its high and low
DAY-TRADING variant — Step 2 (direction confirm): switch to the 5-minute chart and wait for a fair value gap formed through the first candle
DAY-TRADING variant — entry: instead of waiting for a retest, set a LIMIT order on the FVG so entry is automatic once price trades back into the fair value gap
DAY-TRADING variant — stop loss: place it at/under the first candle of the 3-candle FVG pattern
Management rule: after entry, hold through a revisit — do not exit if the market comes down and revisits the fair value gap
